<?php
/* Démo Coiff'Match : Playground peut connecter tout seul le compte admin à l'ouverture. À la toute première page affichée, on le déconnecte pour que la démo commence comme pour une vraie visiteuse. Ensuite plus rien n'est fait : l'admin peut se connecter normalement. */
add_action( 'template_redirect', function () {
	if ( get_option( 'cm_demo_first_view' ) ) {
		return;
	}
	update_option( 'cm_demo_first_view', 1, false );
	if ( is_user_logged_in() && current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
		wp_logout();
		wp_safe_redirect( esc_url_raw( wp_unslash( $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ) ) );
		exit;
	}
}, 0 );

			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_address', mb_substr( sanitize_text_field( $data['address'] ), 0, 120 ) );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['zones'] ) ) {
			$zones = is_array( $data['zones'] ) ? $data['zones'] : explode( ',', (string) $data['zones'] );
			$zones = array_slice( array_values( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( function ( $z ) {
				return mb_substr( sanitize_text_field( $z ), 0, 40 );
			}, $zones ) ) ) ), 0, 12 );
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_zones', $zones );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['travel'] ) ) {
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_travel', max( 0, min( 50, (int) $data['travel'] ) ) );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['bio'] ) ) {
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_bio', mb_substr( sanitize_textarea_field( $data['bio'] ), 0, 400 ) );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['hair'] ) ) {
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_hair', cm_clean_list( $data['hair'], $hair ) );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['tags'] ) ) {
			$tags = is_array( $data['tags'] ) ? $data['tags'] : explode( ',', (string) $data['tags'] );
			$tags = array_slice( array_values( array_filter( array_map( function ( $t ) {
				return mb_substr( sanitize_text_field( $t ), 0, 30 );
			}, $tags ) ) ), 0, 6 );
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_tags', $tags );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['diploma'] ) ) {
			$d = (string) $data['diploma'];
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_diploma', array_key_exists( $d, cm_diplomas() ) ? $d : '' );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['presta'] ) && is_array( $data['presta'] ) ) {
			$out = array();
			foreach ( array_slice( $data['presta'], 0, 12 ) as $i => $p ) {
				$label = isset( $p['label'] ) ? mb_substr( sanitize_text_field( $p['label'] ), 0, 60 ) : '';
				$price = isset( $p['price'] ) ? (int) round( (float) $p['price'] ) : 0;
				if ( '' === $label || $price < 1 || $price > 999 ) {
					continue;
				}
				$service = isset( $p['service'] ) && isset( $svc[ $p['service'] ] ) ? $p['service'] : 'autre';
				$dur     = isset( $p['dur'] ) ? max( 15, min( 480, (int) $p['dur'] ) ) : 60;
				$row     = array( 'k' => 'p' . ( count( $out ) + 1 ), 'label' => $label, 'service' => $service, 'dur' => $dur, 'price' => $price );
				// Supplément selon la longueur des cheveux (0 = même prix).
				$plus = array();
				foreach ( array( 'mi-long', 'long' ) as $len ) {
					$v = isset( $p['plus'][ $len ] ) ? (int) round( (float) $p['plus'][ $len ] ) : 0;
					if ( $v > 0 ) {
						$plus[ $len ] = min( 300, $v );
					}
				}
				if ( $plus ) {
					$row['plus'] = $plus;
				}
				// Entretien conseillé après X semaines (0 = rythme habituel de ce type de prestation).
				$every = isset( $p['every'] ) ? max( 0, min( 52, (int) $p['every'] ) ) : 0;
				if ( $every ) {
					$row['every'] = $every;
				}
				$out[] = $row;
			}
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_presta', $out );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['skills'] ) ) {
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_skills', array_slice( cm_clean_list( $data['skills'], cm_skills() ), 0, 6 ) );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['staff'] ) && is_array( $data['staff'] ) ) {
			// Équipe du salon : chaque coiffeur a son agenda (ses rendez-vous ne bloquent pas les autres).
			$keys  = wp_list_pluck( self::presta( $post_id ), 'k' );
			$used  = array();
			$staff = array();
			foreach ( array_slice( $data['staff'], 0, 8 ) as $m ) {
				$name = isset( $m['name'] ) ? mb_substr( sanitize_text_field( $m['name'] ), 0, 30 ) : '';
				if ( '' === $name ) {
					continue;
				}
				$k = isset( $m['k'] ) && preg_match( '/^s\d{1,3}$/', (string) $m['k'] ) && ! in_array( $m['k'], $used, true ) ? (string) $m['k'] : '';
				$staff[] = array(
					'k'      => $k,
					'name'   => $name,
					'presta' => isset( $m['presta'] ) && is_array( $m['presta'] ) ? array_values( array_intersect( array_map( 'strval', $m['presta'] ), $keys ) ) : array(),
					'days'   => isset( $m['days'] ) && is_array( $m['days'] ) ? array_values( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( 'intval', $m['days'] ), function ( $d ) {
						return $d >= 0 && $d <= 6;
					} ) ) ) : array( 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ),
				);
				if ( $k ) {
					$used[] = $k;
				}
			}
			$n = 1;
			foreach ( $staff as &$m ) {
				while ( '' === $m['k'] ) {
					$try = 's' . $n++;
					if ( ! in_array( $try, $used, true ) ) {
						$m['k'] = $try;
						$used[] = $try;
					}
				}
			}
			unset( $m );
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_staff', $staff );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['week'] ) && is_array( $data['week'] ) ) {
			$allowed = cm_all_hours();
			$week    = array();
			for ( $d = 0; $d < 7; $d++ ) {
				$hours      = isset( $data['week'][ $d ] ) && is_array( $data['week'][ $d ] ) ? $data['week'][ $d ] : array();
				$hours      = array_values( array_intersect( $allowed, array_map( 'strval', $hours ) ) );
				$week[ $d ] = $hours;
			}
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_week', $week );
		}
		if ( isset( $data['off'] ) && is_array( $data['off'] ) ) {
			$off = array_values( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( function ( $d ) {
				return preg_match( '/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', (string) $d ) ? $d : null;
			}, $data['off'] ) ) ) );
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_off', array_slice( $off, 0, 60 ) );
		}
		do_action( 'cm_pro_saved', $post_id, $data );
	}

	/** Équipe du salon (vide pour un coiffeur seul ou à domicile). */
	public static function staff( $post_id ) {
		if ( 'domicile' === get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_mode', true ) ) {
			return array();
		}
		$s = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_staff', true );
		return is_array( $s ) ? $s : array();
	}

	public static function staff_member( $post_id, $k ) {
		foreach ( self::staff( $post_id ) as $m ) {
			if ( $m['k'] === $k ) {
				return $m;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/** Ce membre de l'équipe fait-il cette prestation ? (liste vide = toutes) */
	public static function staff_does( $m, $presta_k ) {
		return ! $m['presta'] || in_array( $presta_k, $m['presta'], true );
	}

	/** Prix d'une prestation selon la longueur des cheveux. */
	public static function price_for( $presta, $length ) {
		$plus = isset( $presta['plus'][ $length ] ) ? (int) $presta['plus'][ $length ] : 0;
		return (int) $presta['price'] + $plus;
	}

	/** Lien privé de l'agenda du coiffeur (abonnement Google Agenda, iPhone, Outlook). */
	public static function ical_token( $post_id, $reset = false ) {
		$t = (string) get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_ical', true );
		if ( $reset || ! preg_match( '/^[a-z0-9]{32}$/', $t ) ) {
			$t = strtolower( wp_generate_password( 32, false ) );
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_ical', $t );
		}
		return $t;
	}

	/** Horaires de la semaine (0 = dimanche). Par défaut : lundi-samedi, créneaux standards. */
	public static function week( $post_id ) {
		$week = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_week', true );
		if ( ! is_array( $week ) || count( $week ) !== 7 ) {
			$week = array();
			for ( $d = 0; $d < 7; $d++ ) {
				$week[ $d ] = 0 === $d ? array() : cm_default_hours();
			}
		}
		return $week;
	}

	public static function zones( $post_id ) {
		$z = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_zones', true );
		return is_array( $z ) ? $z : array();
	}

	/**
	 * Un créneau de $dur minutes à $hour est-il libre ? (aucun chevauchement avec un rendez-vous actif)
	 * $days = résultat de availability() ; renvoie false si le jour ou l'heure n'existe pas.
	 */
	public static function fits( $day, $hour, $dur ) {
		$m = cm_minutes( $hour );
		foreach ( $day['busy'] as $iv ) {
			if ( $m < $iv[1] && $iv[0] < $m + $dur ) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	public static function presta( $post_id ) {
		$p = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_presta', true );
		return is_array( $p ) ? $p : array();
	}

	public static function find_presta( $post_id, $k ) {
		foreach ( self::presta( $post_id ) as $p ) {
			if ( $p['k'] === $k ) {
				return $p;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	/** Heures ouvertes un jour donné. */
	public static function hours_for( $post_id, $date, $staff = '' ) {
		$off = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_off', true );
		if ( is_array( $off ) && in_array( $date, $off, true ) ) {
			return array();
		}
		$dt = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat( 'Y-m-d', $date, wp_timezone() );
		if ( ! $dt ) {
			return array();
		}
		$dow = (int) $dt->format( 'w' );
		if ( $staff ) {
			$m = self::staff_member( $post_id, $staff );
			if ( ! $m || ! in_array( $dow, $m['days'], true ) ) {
				return array();
			}
		}
		$week = self::week( $post_id );
		return $week[ $dow ];
	}

	/** Disponibilités sur les prochains jours : [{date,label,dow,hours:[{h,taken}]}]. */
	public static function availability( $post_id, $staff = '' ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$s     = cm_settings();
		$now   = cm_now();
		$start = $now->modify( 'tomorrow' );
		$end   = $start->modify( '+' . ( (int) $s['booking_days'] - 1 ) . ' days' );
		$rows  = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare(
			'SELECT slot_date, slot_hour, dur FROM ' . cm_table( 'bookings' ) . " WHERE pro_id = %d AND slot_key IS NOT NULL AND slot_date BETWEEN %s AND %s" . ( $staff ? ' AND staff = %s' : ' AND %s = %s' ),
			$post_id, $start->format( 'Y-m-d' ), $end->format( 'Y-m-d' ), $staff ? $staff : '1', $staff ? '' : '1'
		) );
		// Plages occupées par jour, en minutes : un rendez-vous de 4 h bloque toute la matinée.
		$busy = array();
		foreach ( $rows as $r ) {
			$s                       = cm_minutes( $r->slot_hour );
			$busy[ $r->slot_date ][] = array( $s, $s + max( 15, (int) $r->dur ) );
		}
		$days = array();
		for ( $d = $start; $d <= $end; $d = $d->modify( '+1 day' ) ) {
			$date  = $d->format( 'Y-m-d' );
			$b     = isset( $busy[ $date ] ) ? $busy[ $date ] : array();
			$hours = array();
			foreach ( self::hours_for( $post_id, $date, $staff ) as $h ) {
				$m     = cm_minutes( $h );
				$taken = false;
				foreach ( $b as $iv ) {
					if ( $m >= $iv[0] && $m < $iv[1] ) {
						$taken = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				$hours[] = array( 'h' => $h, 'm' => $m, 'taken' => $taken );
			}
			$days[] = array( 'date' => $date, 'label' => cm_date_label( $date ), 'dow' => (int) $d->format( 'w' ), 'day' => (int) $d->format( 'j' ), 'hours' => $hours, 'busy' => $b );
		}
		return $days;
	}

	/** Note moyenne et nombre d'avis. */
	public static function rating( $post_id ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$r = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(rating) AS avg FROM ' . cm_table( 'reviews' ) . ' WHERE pro_id = %d AND hidden = 0', $post_id ) );
		return array( 'n' => (int) $r->n, 'avg' => $r->n ? round( (float) $r->avg, 1 ) : null );
	}

	public static function photos( $post_id, $size = 'medium_large' ) {
		$ids = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_photos', true );
		$out = array();
		foreach ( is_array( $ids ) ? $ids : array() as $id ) {
			$url = wp_get_attachment_image_url( $id, $size );
			if ( $url ) {
				// Étiquette « avant » / « après » posée par le coiffeur, pour montrer la transformation.
				$out[] = array( 'id' => (int) $id, 'url' => $url, 'tag' => (string) get_post_meta( $id, '_cm_tag', true ) );
			}
		}
		return $out;
	}

	public static function geo( $post_id ) {
		$g = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_geo', true );
		return is_array( $g ) && 2 === count( $g ) ? array( (float) $g[0], (float) $g[1] ) : null;
	}

		$data = array(

			'mode'     => get_post_meta( $id, '_cm_mode', true ) ?: 'salon',
			'place'    => (string) get_post_meta( $id, '_cm_place', true ),
			'hair'     => is_array( $hair ) ? $hair : array(),
			'tags'     => is_array( $tags ) ? $tags : array(),
			'skills'   => is_array( $skills ) ? $skills : array(),
			'staff'    => array_map( function ( $m ) {
				return array( 'k' => $m['k'], 'name' => $m['name'], 'presta' => $m['presta'] );

			'presta'   => self::presta( $id ),
			'rating'   => self::rating( $id ),
			'photos'   => self::photos( $id, $full ? 'medium_large' : 'medium' ),
			'created'  => get_post_time( 'Y-m-d', false, $id ),
			'owner'    => (int) $post->post_author,
			'zones'    => self::zones( $id ),
			'travel'   => (int) get_post_meta( $id, '_cm_travel', true ),
			'address'  => 'salon' === ( get_post_meta( $id, '_cm_mode', true ) ?: 'salon' ) ? (string) get_post_meta( $id, '_cm_address', true ) : '',
			'geo'      => self::geo( $id ),
			// Visuels de texture à afficher tant qu'il n'y a pas (assez) de photos.
			'art'      => array_map( function ( $i ) use ( $id, $hair ) {
				$h = is_array( $hair ) && $hair ? $hair[ $i % count( $hair ) ] : 'boucles';
				return CM_Art::url( $h, $id * 10 + $i );
			}, range( 0, 5 ) ),
			'url'      => class_exists( 'CM_Public' ) ? CM_Public::pro_url( $id ) : '',

		if ( $full ) {
			global $wpdb;
			$data['bio']     = (string) get_post_meta( $id, '_cm_bio', true );
			$data['diploma'] = (string) get_post_meta( $id, '_cm_diploma', true );

			$data['reviews'] = array_map( function ( $r ) {
				$photo = $r->photo_id ? wp_get_attachment_image_url( (int) $r->photo_id, 'medium' ) : '';
				return array( 'id' => (int) $r->id, 'rating' => (int) $r->rating, 'body' => $r->body, 'reply' => (string) $r->reply, 'firstName' => $r->first_name, 'hair' => $r->hair, 'photo' => $photo ? $photo : '', 'date' => mysql2date( 'j M Y', $r->created ) );
			}, $rows );
			$data['days']    = self::availability( $id );
			if ( $staff ) {

					$data['staffDays'][ $m['k'] ] = self::availability( $id, $m['k'] );
				}
			}
		}
		return $data;
	}

class CM_Mail {

	public static function init() {
		add_action( 'phpmailer_init', array( __CLASS__, 'configure' ) );
		add_filter( 'wp_mail_from', array( __CLASS__, 'from_email' ) );
		add_filter( 'wp_mail_from_name', array( __CLASS__, 'from_name' ) );
		add_action( 'wp_mail_failed', array( __CLASS__, 'log_failure' ) );
	}

	public static function defaults() {
		return array(
			'from_name'  => '',
			'from_email' => '',
			'host'       => '',
			'port'       => 587,
			'secure'     => 'tls',
			'user'       => '',
			'pass'       => '',
		);
	}

	/** Réglages effectifs (constantes de wp-config.php prioritaires). */
	public static function settings() {
		$s = wp_parse_args( (array) get_option( 'cm_mail', array() ), self::defaults() );
		$map = array( 'host' => 'CM_SMTP_HOST', 'port' => 'CM_SMTP_PORT', 'secure' => 'CM_SMTP_SECURE', 'user' => 'CM_SMTP_USER', 'pass' => 'CM_SMTP_PASS' );
		foreach ( $map as $k => $const ) {
			if ( defined( $const ) ) {
				$s[ $k ] = constant( $const );
			}
		}
		return $s;
	}

	public static function uses_constants() {
		return defined( 'CM_SMTP_HOST' );
	}

	public static function is_configured() {
		$s = self::settings();
		return '' !== trim( (string) $s['host'] );
	}

	public static function save( $input ) {
		$old = wp_parse_args( (array) get_option( 'cm_mail', array() ), self::defaults() );
		$out = array(
			'from_name'  => isset( $input['from_name'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $input['from_name'] ) ) : '',
			'from_email' => isset( $input['from_email'] ) ? sanitize_email( wp_unslash( $input['from_email'] ) ) : '',
			'host'       => isset( $input['host'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $input['host'] ) ) : '',
			'port'       => isset( $input['port'] ) ? max( 1, min( 65535, (int) $input['port'] ) ) : 587,
			'secure'     => isset( $input['secure'] ) && in_array( $input['secure'], array( 'tls', 'ssl', '' ), true ) ? $input['secure'] : 'tls',
			'user'       => isset( $input['user'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $input['user'] ) ) : '',
			// Champ laissé vide = on garde le mot de passe déjà enregistré.
			'pass'       => isset( $input['pass'] ) && '' !== $input['pass'] ? (string) wp_unslash( $input['pass'] ) : $old['pass'], // phpcs:ignore -- mot de passe non modifié.
		);
		if ( ! empty( $input['pass_clear'] ) ) {
			$out['pass'] = '';
		}
		update_option( 'cm_mail', $out, false );
	}

	public static function configure( $phpmailer ) {
		$s = self::settings();
		if ( '' === trim( (string) $s['host'] ) ) {
			return;
		}
		$phpmailer->isSMTP();
		$phpmailer->Host       = $s['host'];
		$phpmailer->Port       = (int) $s['port'];
		$phpmailer->SMTPSecure = $s['secure'];
		$phpmailer->SMTPAutoTLS = 'tls' === $s['secure'];
		$phpmailer->SMTPAuth   = '' !== (string) $s['user'];
		$phpmailer->Username   = $s['user'];
		$phpmailer->Password   = $s['pass'];
		$phpmailer->Timeout    = 15;
		$phpmailer->CharSet    = 'UTF-8';
	}

	public static function from_email( $email ) {
		$s = self::settings();
		return is_email( $s['from_email'] ) ? $s['from_email'] : $email;
	}

	public static function from_name( $name ) {
		$s = self::settings();
		return '' !== $s['from_name'] ? $s['from_name'] : wp_specialchars_decode( get_bloginfo( 'name' ), ENT_QUOTES );
	}

	public static function log_failure( $error ) {
		update_option( 'cm_mail_last_error', array( 'time' => current_time( 'mysql' ), 'msg' => mb_substr( $error->get_error_message(), 0, 300 ) ), false );
	}

	/** Envoie un e-mail de test. Retourne true ou le message d'erreur. */
	public static function send_test( $to ) {
		delete_option( 'cm_mail_last_error' );
		$ok = wp_mail( $to, 'Test d\'envoi – ' . wp_specialchars_decode( get_bloginfo( 'name' ), ENT_QUOTES ), "Bonjour,\n\nSi vous lisez ce message, les e-mails de votre site partent correctement.\n\nPensez à vérifier qu'il n'est pas arrivé dans les spams." );
		if ( $ok ) {
			update_option( 'cm_mail_tested', current_time( 'mysql' ), false );
			return true;
		}
		$err = get_option( 'cm_mail_last_error' );
		return $err ? $err['msg'] : 'Erreur inconnue.';
	}
}

<?php
/**
 * Position des coiffeurs sur la carte. Géocodage par la Base Adresse Nationale (api-adresse.data.gouv.fr :
 * service public gratuit, sans clé). Salon : l'adresse du salon. Domicile : seulement la ville affichée,
 * jamais une adresse personnelle.
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

class CM_Geo {

	public static function init() {
		add_action( 'cm_pro_saved', array( __CLASS__, 'on_save' ), 10, 2 );
	}

	public static function on_save( $post_id, $data ) {
		if ( ! isset( $data['address'] ) && ! isset( $data['place'] ) && ! isset( $data['mode'] ) ) {
			return;
		}
		$mode  = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_mode', true ) ?: 'salon';
		$query = 'salon' === $mode ? (string) get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_address', true ) : '';
		if ( '' === $query ) {
			$query = (string) get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_place', true );
		}
		$key = md5( $mode . '|' . $query );
		if ( get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_geo_key', true ) === $key ) {
			return;
		}
		$geo = self::lookup( $query, 'salon' === $mode && $query !== get_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_place', true ) );
		update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_geo_key', $key );
		if ( $geo ) {
			update_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_geo', $geo );
		} else {
			delete_post_meta( $post_id, '_cm_geo' );
		}
	}

	/** [lat, lng] ou null. */
	public static function lookup( $q, $street = false ) {
		$q = trim( $q );
		if ( mb_strlen( $q ) < 3 ) {
			return null;
		}
		$url = add_query_arg( array( 'q' => $q, 'limit' => 1 ) + ( $street ? array() : array( 'type' => 'municipality' ) ), 'https://api-adresse.data.gouv.fr/search/' );
		$res = wp_remote_get( $url, array( 'timeout' => 4 ) );
		if ( is_wp_error( $res ) || 200 !== wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $res ) ) {
			// Arrondissements de Paris, Lyon, Marseille : « Paris 18e » n'est pas une commune pour l'API.
			return $street ? null : self::fallback( $q );
		}
		$j = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $res ), true );
		if ( empty( $j['features'][0]['geometry']['coordinates'] ) ) {
			return $street ? self::lookup( $q, false ) : self::fallback( $q );
		}
		list( $lng, $lat ) = $j['features'][0]['geometry']['coordinates'];
		return array( round( (float) $lat, 5 ), round( (float) $lng, 5 ) );
	}

	private static function fallback( $q ) {
		if ( preg_match( '/^(paris|lyon|marseille)\s+(\d{1,2})/i', remove_accents( $q ), $m ) ) {
			$cp = array( 'paris' => '750', 'lyon' => '6900', 'marseille' => '130' )[ strtolower( $m[1] ) ] . str_pad( $m[2], 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT );
			$res = wp_remote_get( add_query_arg( array( 'q' => $m[1], 'postcode' => $cp, 'limit' => 1 ), 'https://api-adresse.data.gouv.fr/search/' ), array( 'timeout' => 4 ) );
			if ( ! is_wp_error( $res ) ) {
				$j = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $res ), true );
				if ( ! empty( $j['features'][0]['geometry']['coordinates'] ) ) {
					list( $lng, $lat ) = $j['features'][0]['geometry']['coordinates'];
					return array( round( (float) $lat, 5 ), round( (float) $lng, 5 ) );
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
}

<?php
/**
 * API REST utilisée par l'application (namespace coiffmatch/v1).
 * Authentification : cookie WordPress + en-tête X-WP-Nonce (géré par l'application).
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

class CM_Rest {

	const NS = 'coiffmatch/v1';

	public static function register() {
		$pub  = '__return_true';
		$auth = array( __CLASS__, 'logged_in' );

		self::route( '/pros', 'GET', 'pros', $pub );
		self::route( '/pros/(?P<id>\d+)', 'GET', 'pro', $pub );
		self::route( '/pros/(?P<id>\d+)/view', 'POST', 'pro_view', $pub );
		self::route( '/me', 'GET', 'me', $pub );
		self::route( '/me/bookings', 'GET', 'my_bookings', $auth );
		self::route( '/me/hair', 'POST', 'save_hair', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro/clients/(?P<client>\d+)/note', 'POST', 'pro_client_note', $auth );
		self::route( '/bookings', 'POST', 'create_booking', $auth );
		self::route( '/booking-photos', 'POST', 'booking_photo', $auth );
		self::route( '/booking-photos/(?P<att>\d+)', 'DELETE', 'booking_photo_delete', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro/ical', 'POST', 'pro_ical_reset', $auth );
		self::route( '/bookings/(?P<id>\d+)/cancel', 'POST', 'cancel_booking', $auth );
		self::route( '/reviews', 'POST', 'create_review', $auth );
		self::route( '/favs/(?P<id>\d+)', 'POST', 'toggle_fav', $auth );
		self::route( '/threads', 'GET', 'threads', $auth );
		self::route( '/threads/(?P<pro>\d+)/(?P<client>\d+)', 'GET', 'thread', $auth );
		self::route( '/threads/(?P<pro>\d+)/(?P<client>\d+)', 'POST', 'send_message', $auth );
		self::route( '/reports', 'POST', 'create_report', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro', 'GET', 'pro_space', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro', 'POST', 'pro_save', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro/withdraw', 'POST', 'pro_withdraw', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro/photos', 'POST', 'pro_photo_add', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro/photos/(?P<att>\d+)', 'DELETE', 'pro_photo_delete', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro/photos/(?P<att>\d+)/tag', 'POST', 'pro_photo_tag', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro/bookings/(?P<id>\d+)', 'POST', 'pro_booking_status', $auth );
		self::route( '/pro/reviews/(?P<id>\d+)/reply', 'POST', 'pro_review_reply', $auth );
	}

	private static function route( $path, $method, $cb, $perm ) {
		register_rest_route( self::NS, $path, array(
			'methods'             => $method,
			'callback'            => array( __CLASS__, $cb ),
			'permission_callback' => $perm,
		) );
	}

	public static function logged_in() {
		return is_user_logged_in() ? true : new WP_Error( 'cm_login', 'Connectez-vous pour continuer.', array( 'status' => 401 ) );
	}

	private static function err( $code, $msg, $status = 400 ) {
		return new WP_Error( $code, $msg, array( 'status' => $status ) );
	}

	/** Limite simple anti-abus : $max actions par tranche de 10 minutes. */
	private static function throttle( $key, $max ) {
		$k = 'cm_rl_' . $key . '_' . get_current_user_id();
		$n = (int) get_transient( $k );
		if ( $n >= $max ) {
			return false;
		}
		set_transient( $k, $n + 1, 10 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS );
		return true;
	}

	private static function favs( $user_id ) {
		$f = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'cm_favs', true );
		return is_array( $f ) ? array_map( 'intval', $f ) : array();
	}

	/** Toutes les fiches (y compris exemples) appartenant à l'utilisateur. */
	private static function owned_pro_ids( $user_id ) {
		return array_map( 'intval', get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'cm_pro', 'post_status' => 'any', 'author' => $user_id, 'numberposts' => 50, 'fields' => 'ids' ) ) );
	}

	/* ---------------- Recherche ---------------- */

	public static function pros( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$hair     = sanitize_key( (string) $r['hair'] );
		$service  = sanitize_key( (string) $r['service'] );
		$where    = sanitize_key( (string) $r['where'] );
		$city     = mb_strtolower( remove_accents( sanitize_text_field( (string) $r['city'] ) ) );
		$sort     = sanitize_key( (string) $r['sort'] );
		$verified = ! empty( $r['verified'] ) && 'false' !== $r['verified'];
		$fav      = ! empty( $r['fav'] ) && 'false' !== $r['fav'];
		$avail    = 'tomorrow' === (string) $r['avail'];
		$maxprice = (int) $r['maxprice'];
		$skill    = sanitize_key( (string) $r['skill'] );
		$skill    = isset( cm_skills()[ $skill ] ) ? $skill : '';
		$favs     = is_user_logged_in() ? self::favs( get_current_user_id() ) : array();

		$posts = get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'cm_pro', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'numberposts' => 300 ) );
		$out   = array();
		foreach ( $posts as $p ) {
			$d = CM_Pros::public_data( $p );
			if ( $hair && ! in_array( $hair, $d['hair'], true ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			if ( $skill && ! in_array( $skill, $d['skills'], true ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			$prices = array();
			foreach ( $d['presta'] as $x ) {
				if ( ! $service || $x['service'] === $service ) {
					$prices[] = (int) $x['price'];
				}
			}
			if ( ! $prices ) {
				continue;
			}
			if ( in_array( $where, array( 'salon', 'domicile' ), true ) && $d['mode'] !== $where ) {
				continue;
			}
			if ( $city ) {
				$hay = mb_strtolower( remove_accents( $d['place'] . ' | ' . implode( ' | ', $d['zones'] ) . ' | ' . $d['address'] ) );
				if ( false === strpos( $hay, $city ) ) {
					continue;
				}
			}
			if ( $maxprice && min( $prices ) > $maxprice ) {
				continue;
			}
			if ( $avail ) {
				// Au moins un créneau libre demain pour la plus courte des prestations recherchées.
				$durs = array();
				foreach ( $d['presta'] as $x ) {
					if ( ! $service || $x['service'] === $service ) {
						$durs[] = (int) $x['dur'];
					}
				}
				$first = self::next_slot( $d['id'], min( $durs ) );
				if ( ! $first || 0 !== $first['dayIndex'] ) {
					continue;
				}
			}
			if ( $verified && ! $d['verified'] ) {
				continue;
			}
			if ( $fav && ! in_array( $d['id'], $favs, true ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			$durs = array();
			$keys = array();
			foreach ( $d['presta'] as $x ) {
				if ( ! $service || $x['service'] === $service ) {
					$durs[]  = (int) $x['dur'];
					$keys[ (int) $x['price'] ] = $x['k'];
				}
			}
			ksort( $keys );
			$d['nextPresta'] = reset( $keys );
			$d['next']       = self::next_slot( $d['id'], min( $durs ) );
			$d['minPrice'] = min( $prices );
			$d['fav']      = in_array( $d['id'], $favs, true );
			unset( $d['presta'] );
			$out[] = $d;
		}
		usort( $out, function ( $a, $b ) use ( $sort ) {
			if ( 'price' === $sort ) {
				return $a['minPrice'] - $b['minPrice'];
			}
			if ( 'new' === $sort ) {
				return strcmp( $b['created'], $a['created'] );
			}
			if ( 'soon' === $sort ) {
				$ka = $a['next'] ? $a['next']['date'] . ' ' . str_pad( $a['next']['hour'], 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT ) : '9999';
				$kb = $b['next'] ? $b['next']['date'] . ' ' . str_pad( $b['next']['hour'], 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT ) : '9999';
				return strcmp( $ka, $kb );
			}
			$ra = (float) $a['rating']['avg'];
			$rb = (float) $b['rating']['avg'];
			if ( $ra !== $rb ) {
				return $rb <=> $ra;
			}
			return $b['rating']['n'] - $a['rating']['n'];
		} );
		if ( ! $out && ! $fav && empty( $r['pre'] ) ) {
			CM_Insights::log_missed( $hair, $city );
		}
		return array( 'pros' => $out, 'total' => count( $out ) );
	}

	/** Vue d'un profil déjà préchargé au survol : comptée seulement quand il est vraiment ouvert. */
	public static function pro_view( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$p = get_post( (int) $r['id'] );
		if ( $p && 'cm_pro' === $p->post_type && 'publish' === $p->post_status ) {
			CM_Stats::view( $p->ID );
		}
		return array( 'ok' => true );
	}

	public static function pro( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$p   = get_post( (int) $r['id'] );
		$uid = get_current_user_id();
		if ( ! $p || 'cm_pro' !== $p->post_type ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Coiffeur introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		$owner = $uid && (int) $p->post_author === $uid;
		if ( 'publish' !== $p->post_status && ! $owner && ! current_user_can( 'edit_others_posts' ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Coiffeur introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		if ( empty( $r['pre'] ) ) {
			CM_Stats::view( $p->ID );
		}
		$d          = CM_Pros::public_data( $p, true );
		$d['fav']   = $uid ? in_array( $p->ID, self::favs( $uid ), true ) : false;
		$d['isMine'] = $owner && ! $d['example'];
		global $wpdb;
		$stats = array();
		foreach ( $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT hair, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(rating) AS avg FROM ' . cm_table( 'reviews' ) . " WHERE pro_id = %d AND hidden = 0 AND hair <> '' GROUP BY hair", $p->ID ) ) as $row ) {
			$stats[ $row->hair ] = array( 'n' => (int) $row->n, 'avg' => round( (float) $row->avg, 1 ) );
		}
		$d['hairStats'] = (object) $stats;
		$d['status'] = $p->post_status;
		return $d;
	}

	/* ---------------- Compte ---------------- */

	public static function me() {
		global $wpdb;
		$uid = get_current_user_id();
		if ( ! $uid ) {
			return array( 'loggedIn' => false );
		}
		$pro_id  = CM_Pros::of_user( $uid );
		$owned   = self::owned_pro_ids( $uid );
		$pending = 0;
		if ( $owned ) {
			$in      = implode( ',', $owned );
			$pending = (int) $wpdb->get_var( 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' . cm_table( 'bookings' ) . " WHERE status = 'pending' AND pro_id IN ($in)" ); // phpcs:ignore -- ids entiers.
		}
		$unread = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare(
			'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' . cm_table( 'messages' ) . ' WHERE read_at IS NULL AND sender_id <> %d AND (client_id = %d' . ( $owned ? ' OR pro_id IN (' . implode( ',', $owned ) . ')' : '' ) . ')',
			$uid, $uid
		) );
		return array(
			'loggedIn'  => true,
			'id'        => $uid,
			'firstName' => cm_user_first_name( $uid ),
			'isPro'     => (bool) $pro_id || user_can( $uid, 'cm_coiffeur' ) || in_array( 'cm_coiffeur', (array) get_userdata( $uid )->roles, true ),
			'proId'     => $pro_id,
			'proStatus' => $pro_id ? get_post_status( $pro_id ) : '',
			'favs'      => self::favs( $uid ),
			'pending'   => $pending,
			'unread'    => $unread,
			'isAdmin'   => current_user_can( 'manage_options' ),
			'role'      => cm_is_team() ? 'admin' : ( cm_is_coiffeur() ? 'coiffeur' : 'client' ),
			'phone'     => (string) get_user_meta( $uid, 'cm_phone', true ),
			'hairProfile' => (object) cm_clean_hair_profile( get_user_meta( $uid, 'cm_hair_profile', true ) ),
			'address'   => (string) get_user_meta( $uid, 'cm_address', true ),
		);
	}

	public static function save_hair( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$p = cm_clean_hair_profile( $r->get_json_params() );
		update_user_meta( get_current_user_id(), 'cm_hair_profile', $p );
		return array( 'hairProfile' => (object) $p, 'text' => cm_hair_profile_text( $p ) );
	}

	public static function pro_client_note( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$pro_id = CM_Pros::of_user( get_current_user_id() );
		$client = (int) $r['client'];
		if ( ! $pro_id || ! $client ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Cliente introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		$known = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT id FROM ' . cm_table( 'bookings' ) . ' WHERE pro_id = %d AND client_id = %d LIMIT 1', $pro_id, $client ) );
		if ( ! $known ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Cette personne n\'a pas encore pris rendez-vous avec vous.', 404 );
		}
		$note = mb_substr( sanitize_textarea_field( (string) $r['note'] ), 0, 1000 );
		$t    = cm_table( 'notes' );
		$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "DELETE FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND client_id = %d", $pro_id, $client ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		if ( '' !== $note ) {
			$wpdb->insert( $t, array( 'pro_id' => $pro_id, 'client_id' => $client, 'note' => $note, 'updated' => current_time( 'mysql' ) ) );
		}
		return array( 'ok' => true, 'note' => $note );
	}

	/** Premier créneau libre (prochains jours) pour une prestation de « $dur » minutes. */
	public static function next_slot( $pro_id, $dur ) {
		$staff = CM_Pros::staff( $pro_id );
		$best  = null;
		// Salon avec une équipe : le premier créneau libre, tous coiffeurs confondus.
		foreach ( $staff ? wp_list_pluck( $staff, 'k' ) : array( '' ) as $k ) {
			foreach ( CM_Pros::availability( $pro_id, $k ) as $i => $day ) {
				if ( $best && $i > $best['dayIndex'] ) {
					break;
				}
				foreach ( $day['hours'] as $h ) {
					if ( CM_Pros::fits( $day, $h['h'], $dur ) ) {
						if ( ! $best || $i < $best['dayIndex'] || ( $i === $best['dayIndex'] && $h['m'] < $best['m'] ) ) {
							$label = 0 === $i ? 'demain' : ( 1 === $i ? 'après-demain' : $day['label'] );
							$best  = array( 'date' => $day['date'], 'hour' => $h['h'], 'label' => $label . ' ' . $h['h'], 'dayIndex' => $i, 'm' => $h['m'], 'staff' => $k );
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if ( $best ) {
			unset( $best['m'] );
		}
		return $best;
	}

	public static function toggle_fav( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$uid  = get_current_user_id();
		$id   = (int) $r['id'];
		$favs = self::favs( $uid );
		if ( in_array( $id, $favs, true ) ) {
			$favs = array_values( array_diff( $favs, array( $id ) ) );
			$on   = false;
		} else {
			if ( 'cm_pro' !== get_post_type( $id ) ) {
				return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Coiffeur introuvable.', 404 );
			}
			$favs[] = $id;
			$on     = true;
		}
		update_user_meta( $uid, 'cm_favs', array_slice( $favs, -100 ) );
		return array( 'fav' => $on, 'favs' => $favs );
	}

	public static function create_booking( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		if ( cm_is_coiffeur() && ! cm_is_team() ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_role', 'Les comptes coiffeur ne réservent pas : utilisez un compte client avec une autre adresse e-mail.', 403 );

		if ( ! self::throttle( 'book', 15 ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_rate', 'Trop de demandes en peu de temps. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.', 429 );
		}
		$b = CM_Bookings::create( get_current_user_id(), (int) $r['pro_id'], sanitize_key( (string) $r['presta'] ), (string) $r['date'], (string) $r['hour'], (string) $r['first_name'], sanitize_key( (string) $r['hair'] ), (string) $r['phone'], (string) $r['address'], is_array( $r['hair_profile'] ) && $r['hair_profile'] ? $r['hair_profile'] : get_user_meta( get_current_user_id(), 'cm_hair_profile', true ), array(
			'length' => sanitize_key( (string) $r['length'] ),

			'staff'  => sanitize_key( (string) $r['staff'] ),

		return CM_Bookings::format( $b );

	/**
	 * Photo des cheveux jointe à une demande : envoyée avant la réservation, visible seulement par la cliente et le coiffeur.
	 * Fichier renommé au hasard, page de pièce jointe privée ; effacée 60 jours après le rendez-vous.
	 */
	public static function booking_photo( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		if ( ! self::throttle( 'bphoto', 20 ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_rate', 'Trop de photos envoyées en peu de temps. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.', 429 );
		}
		$files = $r->get_file_params();
		if ( empty( $files['file'] ) || ! empty( $files['file']['error'] ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_file', 'Aucune photo reçue.' );
		}
		$bad = self::check_image( $files['file'] );
		if ( $bad ) {
			return $bad;
		}
		$ext                    = strtolower( pathinfo( $files['file']['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION ) );
		$files['file']['name']  = 'cheveux-' . strtolower( wp_generate_password( 16, false ) ) . '.' . ( in_array( $ext, array( 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp' ), true ) ? $ext : 'jpg' );
		$att                    = self::store_image( $files['file'], 0 );
		if ( ! $att ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_upload', 'La photo n\'a pas pu être envoyée. Réessayez.' );
		}
		update_post_meta( $att, '_cm_booking_photo', 1 );
		wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $att, 'post_status' => 'private', 'post_title' => 'Photo des cheveux' ) );
		return array( 'id' => $att, 'url' => wp_get_attachment_image_url( $att, 'thumbnail' ) );
	}

	public static function cancel_booking( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$uid = get_current_user_id();
		$b   = CM_Bookings::get( (int) $r['id'] );
		if ( ! $b ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Rendez-vous introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		$is_client = (int) $b->client_id === $uid;
		$is_pro    = CM_Pros::is_owner( $b->pro_id, $uid );
		if ( ! $is_client && ! $is_pro ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_403', 'Ce rendez-vous ne vous concerne pas.', 403 );
		}
		if ( ! in_array( $b->status, array( 'pending', 'confirmed' ), true ) || CM_Bookings::is_past( $b ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_state', 'Ce rendez-vous ne peut plus être annulé.' );
		}
		$late = ! CM_Bookings::is_free_cancel( $b );
		$b    = CM_Bookings::set_status( $b, 'cancelled' );
		CM_Emails::status_changed( $b, $is_pro && ! $is_client );
		return array( 'ok' => true, 'late' => $late );
	}

	public static function create_review( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$uid    = get_current_user_id();
		$b      = CM_Bookings::get( (int) $r['booking_id'] );
		$rating = (int) $r['rating'];
		$body   = mb_substr( sanitize_textarea_field( (string) $r['body'] ), 0, 600 );
		if ( ! $b || (int) $b->client_id !== $uid ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Rendez-vous introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		if ( 'confirmed' !== $b->status || ! CM_Bookings::is_past( $b ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_state', 'Vous pourrez laisser un avis après votre rendez-vous.' );
		}
		if ( $rating < 1 || $rating > 5 ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_rating', 'Choisissez une note de 1 à 5 étoiles.' );
		}
		if ( mb_strlen( $body ) < 5 ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_body', 'Écrivez quelques mots sur votre expérience.' );
		}
		$files = $r->get_file_params();
		$photo = ! empty( $files['photo'] ) && empty( $files['photo']['error'] ) ? $files['photo'] : null;
		if ( $photo ) {
			$bad = self::check_image( $photo );
			if ( $bad ) {
				return $bad;
			}
		}
		$suppress = $wpdb->suppress_errors( true ); // Un deuxième avis sur le même rendez-vous est refusé par la base.
		$ok       = $wpdb->insert( cm_table( 'reviews' ), array(
			'booking_id' => $b->id,
			'pro_id'     => $b->pro_id,
			'client_id'  => $uid,
			'rating'     => $rating,
			'body'       => $body,
			'reply'      => '',
			'first_name' => $b->first_name,
			'hair'       => $b->hair,
			'created'    => current_time( 'mysql' ),
		) );
		$wpdb->suppress_errors( $suppress );
		if ( ! $ok ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_dup', 'Vous avez déjà laissé un avis pour ce rendez-vous.' );
		}
		$review_id = (int) $wpdb->insert_id;
		if ( $photo ) {
			$att = self::store_image( $photo, (int) $b->pro_id );
			if ( $att ) {
				update_post_meta( $att, '_cm_review_photo', 1 );
				$wpdb->update( cm_table( 'reviews' ), array( 'photo_id' => $att ), array( 'id' => $review_id ) );
			}
		}
		return array( 'ok' => true );
	}

	/** Contrôle d'une image envoyée : renvoie une erreur ou null. */
	private static function check_image( $file ) {
		if ( $file['size'] > 6 * MB_IN_BYTES ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_size', 'Photo trop lourde (6 Mo maximum).' );
		}
		$check = wp_check_filetype_and_ext( $file['tmp_name'], $file['name'] );
		if ( ! in_array( $check['type'], array( 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp' ), true ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_type', 'Formats acceptés : JPG, PNG ou WebP.' );
		}
		return null;
	}

	private static function store_image( $file, $parent ) {
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
		$_FILES['cm_upload'] = $file;
		$att                 = media_handle_upload( 'cm_upload', $parent, array(), array( 'test_form' => false ) );
		return is_wp_error( $att ) ? 0 : (int) $att;
	}

	/* ---------------- Messagerie ---------------- */

	private static function can_access_thread( $pro_id, $client_id, $uid ) {
		return (int) $client_id === $uid || CM_Pros::is_owner( $pro_id, $uid );
	}

	public static function threads() {
		global $wpdb;
		$uid   = get_current_user_id();
		$owned = self::owned_pro_ids( $uid );
		$where = $wpdb->prepare( 'client_id = %d', $uid );
		if ( $owned ) {
			$where .= ' OR pro_id IN (' . implode( ',', $owned ) . ')';
		}
		$t    = cm_table( 'messages' );
		$rows = $wpdb->get_results( "SELECT pro_id, client_id, MAX(id) AS last_id FROM $t WHERE $where GROUP BY pro_id, client_id ORDER BY last_id DESC LIMIT 100" ); // phpcs:ignore
		$out  = array();
		foreach ( $rows as $row ) {
			$last     = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $t WHERE id = %d", $row->last_id ) ); // phpcs:ignore
			$as_pro   = in_array( (int) $row->pro_id, $owned, true ) && (int) $row->client_id !== $uid;
			$unread   = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND client_id = %d AND sender_id <> %d AND read_at IS NULL", $row->pro_id, $row->client_id, $uid ) ); // phpcs:ignore
			$out[]    = array(
				'proId'    => (int) $row->pro_id,
				'clientId' => (int) $row->client_id,
				'asPro'    => $as_pro,
				'title'    => $as_pro ? cm_user_first_name( $row->client_id ) : get_the_title( $row->pro_id ),
				'last'     => mb_substr( $last->body, 0, 80 ),
				'lastMine' => (int) $last->sender_id === $uid,
				'unread'   => $unread,
				'date'     => mysql2date( 'j M, H:i', $last->created ),
			);
		}
		return $out;
	}

	public static function thread( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$uid    = get_current_user_id();
		$pro    = (int) $r['pro'];
		$client = (int) $r['client'];
		if ( 'cm_pro' !== get_post_type( $pro ) || ! self::can_access_thread( $pro, $client, $uid ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_403', 'Conversation introuvable.', 403 );
		}
		$t = cm_table( 'messages' );
		$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "UPDATE $t SET read_at = %s WHERE pro_id = %d AND client_id = %d AND sender_id <> %d AND read_at IS NULL", current_time( 'mysql' ), $pro, $client, $uid ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$rows   = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND client_id = %d ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 300", $pro, $client ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$as_pro = CM_Pros::is_owner( $pro, $uid ) && $client !== $uid;
		return array(
			'proId'    => $pro,
			'clientId' => $client,
			'title'    => $as_pro ? cm_user_first_name( $client ) : get_the_title( $pro ),
			'messages' => array_map( function ( $m ) use ( $uid ) {
				return array( 'id' => (int) $m->id, 'mine' => (int) $m->sender_id === $uid, 'body' => $m->body, 'date' => mysql2date( 'j M, H:i', $m->created ) );
			}, $rows ),
		);
	}

	public static function send_message( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$uid    = get_current_user_id();
		$pro    = (int) $r['pro'];
		$client = (int) $r['client'];
		$body   = mb_substr( sanitize_textarea_field( (string) $r['body'] ), 0, 1000 );
		$p      = get_post( $pro );
		if ( ! $p || 'cm_pro' !== $p->post_type || ! self::can_access_thread( $pro, $client, $uid ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_403', 'Conversation introuvable.', 403 );
		}
		if ( (int) $p->post_author === $client && ! get_post_meta( $pro, '_cm_example', true ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_self', 'Vous ne pouvez pas vous écrire à vous-même.' );
		}
		if ( 'publish' !== $p->post_status && (int) $client === $uid ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Ce coiffeur n\'est pas disponible.', 404 );
		}
		if ( '' === trim( $body ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_empty', 'Écrivez votre message.' );
		}
		if ( ! self::throttle( 'msg', 40 ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_rate', 'Trop de messages en peu de temps. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.', 429 );
		}
		$wpdb->insert( cm_table( 'messages' ), array( 'pro_id' => $pro, 'client_id' => $client, 'sender_id' => $uid, 'body' => $body, 'created' => current_time( 'mysql' ) ) );
		$to = $uid === $client ? (int) $p->post_author : $client;
		// Un seul e-mail tant que le destinataire n'a pas lu la conversation.
		$unread = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' . cm_table( 'messages' ) . ' WHERE pro_id = %d AND client_id = %d AND sender_id = %d AND read_at IS NULL', $pro, $client, $uid ) );
		if ( 1 === $unread ) {
			CM_Emails::new_message( $to, $uid === $client ? cm_user_first_name( $uid ) : get_the_title( $pro ) );
		}
		return self::thread( $r );
	}

	public static function create_report( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$type   = 'review' === $r['type'] ? 'review' : 'pro';
		$target = (int) $r['target_id'];
		$reason = mb_substr( sanitize_text_field( (string) $r['reason'] ), 0, 60 );
		if ( ! $target || '' === $reason ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_report', 'Choisissez un motif.' );
		}
		if ( ! self::throttle( 'report', 10 ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_rate', 'Trop de signalements en peu de temps.', 429 );
		}
		$pro_id = 'pro' === $type ? $target : (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT pro_id FROM ' . cm_table( 'reviews' ) . ' WHERE id = %d', $target ) );
		$wpdb->insert( cm_table( 'reports' ), array( 'type' => $type, 'target_id' => $target, 'pro_id' => $pro_id, 'reason' => $reason, 'reporter_id' => get_current_user_id(), 'status' => 'open', 'created' => current_time( 'mysql' ) ) );
		return array( 'ok' => true );
	}

	public static function pro_space() {
		global $wpdb;
		$uid    = get_current_user_id();
		$pro_id = CM_Pros::of_user( $uid );
		$data   = array( 'profile' => self::pro_edit_data( $pro_id ), 'requests' => array(), 'agenda' => array(), 'reviews' => array(), 'stats' => array( 'upcoming' => 0, 'done' => 0, 'rating' => null, 'reviews' => 0 ) );
		if ( ! $pro_id ) {
			return $data;
		}
		$t     = cm_table( 'bookings' );
		$today = cm_now()->format( 'Y-m-d' );
		$req   = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND status = 'pending' AND slot_date >= %s ORDER BY slot_date, slot_hour", $pro_id, $today ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$ag    = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND status = 'confirmed' AND slot_date >= %s ORDER BY slot_date, slot_hour LIMIT 50", $pro_id, $today ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$fmt   = function ( $b ) {
			return CM_Bookings::format( $b, 'pro' );
		};
		$data['requests'] = array_values( array_filter( array_map( $fmt, $req ), function ( $b ) {
			return ! $b['past'];
		} ) );
		$data['agenda']   = array_values( array_filter( array_map( $fmt, $ag ), function ( $b ) {
			return ! $b['past'];
		} ) );
		$rows             = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT * FROM ' . cm_table( 'reviews' ) . ' WHERE pro_id = %d ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 50', $pro_id ) );
		$data['reviews']  = array_map( function ( $v ) {
			return array( 'id' => (int) $v->id, 'rating' => (int) $v->rating, 'body' => $v->body, 'reply' => (string) $v->reply, 'firstName' => $v->first_name, 'hair' => $v->hair, 'date' => mysql2date( 'j M Y', $v->created ) );
		}, $rows );
		// Agenda des 7 prochains jours (demandes et rendez-vous confirmés).
		$now  = cm_now();
		$week = array();
		for ( $i = 0; $i < 7; $i++ ) {
			$d      = $now->modify( '+' . $i . ' days' );
			$week[] = array( 'date' => $d->format( 'Y-m-d' ), 'dow' => (int) $d->format( 'w' ), 'day' => (int) $d->format( 'j' ), 'label' => cm_date_label( $d->format( 'Y-m-d' ) ), 'hours' => CM_Pros::hours_for( $pro_id, $d->format( 'Y-m-d' ) ), 'items' => array() );
		}
		$rows = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND status IN ('pending','confirmed') AND slot_date BETWEEN %s AND %s ORDER BY slot_date, slot_hour", $pro_id, $now->format( 'Y-m-d' ), $now->modify( '+6 days' )->format( 'Y-m-d' ) ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		foreach ( $rows as $b ) {
			foreach ( $week as &$w ) {
				if ( $w['date'] === $b->slot_date ) {
					$w['items'][] = array( 'id' => (int) $b->id, 'hour' => $b->slot_hour, 'm' => cm_minutes( $b->slot_hour ), 'dur' => (int) $b->dur, 'label' => $b->label, 'firstName' => $b->first_name, 'status' => $b->status );
				}
			}
			unset( $w );
		}
		$data['week'] = $week;

		// Chiffres du mois en cours et fidélité.
		$month_start = $now->format( 'Y-m-01' );
		$month_end   = $now->format( 'Y-m-t' );
		$m           = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(price + travel), 0) AS total FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND status = 'confirmed' AND slot_date BETWEEN %s AND %s", $pro_id, $month_start, $month_end ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$since       = $now->modify( '-90 days' )->format( 'Y-m-d' );
		$all         = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND slot_date >= %s AND status IN ('confirmed','cancelled')", $pro_id, $since ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$cancelled   = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND slot_date >= %s AND status = 'cancelled'", $pro_id, $since ) ); // phpcs:ignore

		// Fichier clientes : une ligne par cliente, avec historique et note privée.
		$clients = array();
		$crow    = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND client_id > 0 AND status IN ('pending','confirmed') ORDER BY slot_date DESC, slot_hour DESC", $pro_id ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		$today_k = $now->format( 'Y-m-d' );
		foreach ( $crow as $b ) {
			$c = (int) $b->client_id;
			if ( ! isset( $clients[ $c ] ) ) {
				$clients[ $c ] = array( 'id' => $c, 'firstName' => $b->first_name, 'hair' => $b->hair, 'hairProfile' => cm_hair_profile_text( $b->hair_profile ), 'phone' => $b->phone, 'visits' => 0, 'spent' => 0, 'last' => '', 'next' => '', 'note' => '' );
			}
			$past = $b->slot_date < $today_k;
			if ( 'confirmed' === $b->status && $past ) {
				$clients[ $c ]['visits']++;
				$clients[ $c ]['spent'] += (int) $b->price + (int) $b->travel;
				if ( ! $clients[ $c ]['last'] ) {
					$clients[ $c ]['last'] = cm_date_label( $b->slot_date );
				}
			} elseif ( ! $past ) {
				$clients[ $c ]['next'] = cm_date_label( $b->slot_date ) . ' à ' . $b->slot_hour;
			}
		}
		if ( $clients ) {
			foreach ( $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT client_id, note FROM ' . cm_table( 'notes' ) . ' WHERE pro_id = %d', $pro_id ) ) as $n ) {
				if ( isset( $clients[ (int) $n->client_id ] ) ) {
					$clients[ (int) $n->client_id ]['note'] = $n->note;
				}
			}
		}
		$data['clients'] = array_values( $clients );
		$loyal           = count( array_filter( $clients, function ( $c ) {
			return $c['visits'] >= 2;
		} ) );

		$rating           = CM_Pros::rating( $pro_id );
		$data['month']    = array(
			'label'      => array( 'janvier', 'février', 'mars', 'avril', 'mai', 'juin', 'juillet', 'août', 'septembre', 'octobre', 'novembre', 'décembre' )[ (int) $now->format( 'n' ) - 1 ],
			'rdv'        => (int) $m->n,
			'revenue'    => (int) $m->total,
			'cancelRate' => $all ? round( 100 * $cancelled / $all ) : 0,
			'loyal'      => $loyal,
			'clients'    => count( $clients ),
		);
		$data['stats']    = array(
			'upcoming' => count( $data['agenda'] ),
			'done'     => (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND status = 'confirmed' AND slot_date < %s", $pro_id, $today ) ), // phpcs:ignore
			'rating'   => $rating['avg'],
			'reviews'  => $rating['n'],
		);
		$data['audience'] = CM_Stats::summary( $pro_id );
		$data['waiting']  = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ' . cm_table( 'waitlist' ) . ' WHERE pro_id = %d AND slot_date >= %s AND notified = 0', $pro_id, $today ) );
		return $data;
	}

	public static function pro_save( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$uid  = get_current_user_id();
		if ( ! cm_is_coiffeur() && ! cm_is_team() ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_role', 'Ce compte est un compte client. Créez un compte coiffeur sur l\'Espace coiffeur pour publier un profil.', 403 );
		}
		$name = mb_substr( sanitize_text_field( (string) $r['name'] ), 0, 40 );
		if ( '' === $name ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_name', 'Indiquez le nom affiché sur votre profil.' );
		}
		if ( '' === trim( (string) $r['place'] ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_place', 'Indiquez votre ville ou votre quartier.' );
		}
		if ( 'domicile' !== (string) $r['mode'] && mb_strlen( trim( (string) $r['address'] ) ) < 8 ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_address', 'Indiquez l\'adresse du salon (numéro, rue, code postal, ville).' );
		}
		if ( ! cm_clean_list( $r['hair'], cm_hair_types() ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_hair', 'Choisissez au moins un type de cheveux que vous maîtrisez.' );
		}
		$pro_id = CM_Pros::of_user( $uid );
		$new    = ! $pro_id;
		$was    = $new ? '' : get_post_status( $pro_id );
		if ( $new ) {
			$pro_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'cm_pro', 'post_status' => 'pending', 'post_title' => $name, 'post_author' => $uid ), true );
			if ( is_wp_error( $pro_id ) ) {
				return self::err( 'cm_save', 'Le profil n\'a pas pu être enregistré.' );
			}
			$user = get_userdata( $uid );
			if ( $user && ! in_array( 'cm_coiffeur', (array) $user->roles, true ) && ! user_can( $uid, 'manage_options' ) ) {
				$user->add_role( 'cm_coiffeur' );
			}
		} else {
			$status = get_post_status( $pro_id );
			wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $pro_id, 'post_title' => $name, 'post_status' => 'draft' === $status ? 'pending' : $status ) );
		}
		CM_Pros::save_meta( $pro_id, array(
			'mode'    => (string) $r['mode'],
			'place'   => (string) $r['place'],
			'bio'     => (string) $r['bio'],
			'hair'    => $r['hair'],
			'tags'    => $r['tags'],
			'skills'  => is_array( $r['skills'] ) ? $r['skills'] : array(),
			'diploma' => (string) $r['diploma'],
			'presta'  => is_array( $r['presta'] ) ? $r['presta'] : array(),
			'week'    => is_array( $r['week'] ) ? $r['week'] : null,
			'off'     => is_array( $r['off'] ) ? $r['off'] : array(),
			'address' => 'domicile' === (string) $r['mode'] ? '' : (string) $r['address'],
			'zones'   => 'domicile' === (string) $r['mode'] ? $r['zones'] : array(),
			'travel'  => 'domicile' === (string) $r['mode'] ? (int) $r['travel'] : 0,
		) );
		// L'équipe est enregistrée après les prestations (elle y fait référence).
		CM_Pros::save_meta( $pro_id, array( 'staff' => 'domicile' === (string) $r['mode'] || ! is_array( $r['staff'] ) ? array() : $r['staff'] ) );
		if ( ! CM_Pros::presta( $pro_id ) ) {
			// Profil enregistré mais incomplet : on le garde hors ligne.
			if ( 'publish' === get_post_status( $pro_id ) ) {
				wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $pro_id, 'post_status' => 'pending' ) );
			}
			return self::err( 'cm_presta', 'Ajoutez au moins une prestation avec un nom et un prix.' );
		}
		if ( $new || 'draft' === $was ) {
			CM_Emails::pro_submitted( $pro_id );
		}
		return self::pro_space();
	}

	public static function pro_photo_add( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$pro_id = CM_Pros::of_user( get_current_user_id() );
		if ( ! $pro_id ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_pro', 'Enregistrez d\'abord votre profil, puis ajoutez vos photos.' );
		}
		$photos = get_post_meta( $pro_id, '_cm_photos', true );
		$photos = is_array( $photos ) ? $photos : array();
		if ( count( $photos ) >= 12 ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_max', 'Vous avez atteint le maximum de 12 photos.' );
		}
		$files = $r->get_file_params();
		if ( empty( $files['file'] ) || ! empty( $files['file']['error'] ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_file', 'Aucune photo reçue.' );
		}
		if ( $files['file']['size'] > 6 * MB_IN_BYTES ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_size', 'Photo trop lourde (6 Mo maximum).' );
		}
		$check = wp_check_filetype_and_ext( $files['file']['tmp_name'], $files['file']['name'] );
		if ( ! in_array( $check['type'], array( 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp' ), true ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_type', 'Formats acceptés : JPG, PNG ou WebP.' );
		}
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
		$_FILES['cm_photo'] = $files['file'];
		$att                = media_handle_upload( 'cm_photo', $pro_id, array(), array( 'test_form' => false ) );
		if ( is_wp_error( $att ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_upload', 'La photo n\'a pas pu être envoyée : ' . $att->get_error_message() );
		}
		$photos[] = (int) $att;
		update_post_meta( $pro_id, '_cm_photos', $photos );
		return array( 'photos' => CM_Pros::photos( $pro_id, 'medium' ) );
	}

	public static function pro_photo_delete( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$pro_id = CM_Pros::of_user( get_current_user_id() );
		$att    = (int) $r['att'];
		$photos = $pro_id ? get_post_meta( $pro_id, '_cm_photos', true ) : array();
		$photos = is_array( $photos ) ? array_map( 'intval', $photos ) : array();
		if ( ! in_array( $att, $photos, true ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Photo introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		update_post_meta( $pro_id, '_cm_photos', array_values( array_diff( $photos, array( $att ) ) ) );
		wp_delete_attachment( $att, true );
		return array( 'photos' => CM_Pros::photos( $pro_id, 'medium' ) );
	}

	public static function pro_booking_status( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		$uid    = get_current_user_id();
		$b      = CM_Bookings::get( (int) $r['id'] );
		$status = (string) $r['status'];
		if ( ! $b || ! CM_Pros::is_owner( $b->pro_id, $uid ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Rendez-vous introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		if ( ! in_array( $status, array( 'confirmed', 'refused' ), true ) || 'pending' !== $b->status ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_state', 'Cette demande a déjà été traitée.' );
		}
		$b = CM_Bookings::set_status( $b, $status );
		CM_Emails::status_changed( $b, true );
		return self::pro_space();
	}

	public static function pro_review_reply( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$v = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT * FROM ' . cm_table( 'reviews' ) . ' WHERE id = %d', (int) $r['id'] ) );
		if ( ! $v || ! CM_Pros::is_owner( $v->pro_id, get_current_user_id() ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Avis introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		$reply = mb_substr( sanitize_textarea_field( (string) $r['reply'] ), 0, 600 );
		$wpdb->update( cm_table( 'reviews' ), array( 'reply' => $reply ), array( 'id' => $v->id ) );
		return self::pro_space();
	}
}

 * Sécurité de base, sans extension supplémentaire :
 * - blocage temporaire après 5 échecs de connexion (15 minutes) ;
 * - limite d'inscriptions et de messages de contact par visiteur ;
 * - les adresses e-mail des membres ne peuvent pas être devinées (API utilisateurs et pages auteur fermées) ;

 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

class CM_Security {

	const MAX_FAILS   = 5;
	const LOCK_MINUTES = 15;

	public static function init() {
		add_action( 'wp_login_failed', array( __CLASS__, 'count_failure' ), 5 );
		add_filter( 'authenticate', array( __CLASS__, 'check_lock' ), 30, 3 );
		add_action( 'wp_login', array( __CLASS__, 'clear_failures' ) );

		add_filter( 'xmlrpc_enabled', '__return_false' );
		add_filter( 'wp_headers', array( __CLASS__, 'headers' ) );
		remove_action( 'wp_head', 'wp_generator' );
		remove_action( 'wp_head', 'rsd_link' );
		remove_action( 'wp_head', 'wlwmanifest_link' );
		add_filter( 'the_generator', '__return_empty_string' );

		add_filter( 'rest_endpoints', array( __CLASS__, 'hide_users_api' ) );
		add_action( 'template_redirect', array( __CLASS__, 'block_author_pages' ), 1 );
		add_filter( 'oembed_response_data', array( __CLASS__, 'oembed_no_author' ) );
	}

	private static function key() {
		return 'cm_fail_' . cm_ip_hash();
	}

	public static function is_locked() {
		return (int) get_transient( self::key() ) >= self::MAX_FAILS;
	}

	public static function count_failure() {
		$n = (int) get_transient( self::key() );
		set_transient( self::key(), $n + 1, self::LOCK_MINUTES * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS );
	}

	public static function clear_failures() {
		delete_transient( self::key() );
	}

	public static function check_lock( $user, $username, $password ) {
		if ( '' !== (string) $username && self::is_locked() ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'cm_locked', 'Trop de tentatives de connexion. Réessayez dans ' . self::LOCK_MINUTES . ' minutes.' );
		}
		return $user;
	}

	/** Limite simple par visiteur : $max actions par période. Retourne false si la limite est atteinte. */
	public static function allow( $action, $max, $seconds ) {
		$k = 'cm_rate_' . $action . '_' . cm_ip_hash();
		$n = (int) get_transient( $k );
		if ( $n >= $max ) {
			return false;
		}
		set_transient( $k, $n + 1, $seconds );
		return true;
	}

	public static function headers( $headers ) {
		$headers['X-Content-Type-Options'] = 'nosniff';
		$headers['X-Frame-Options']        = 'SAMEORIGIN';
		$headers['Referrer-Policy']        = 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin';
		$headers['Permissions-Policy']     = 'camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()';
		return $headers;
	}

	/** L'API /wp/v2/users révélerait les identifiants (dérivés des e-mails) : réservée aux administrateurs. */
	public static function hide_users_api( $endpoints ) {
		if ( current_user_can( 'list_users' ) ) {
			return $endpoints;
		}
		foreach ( array_keys( $endpoints ) as $route ) {
			if ( 0 === strpos( $route, '/wp/v2/users' ) && '/wp/v2/users/me' !== $route ) {
				unset( $endpoints[ $route ] );
			}
		}
		return $endpoints;
	}

	public static function block_author_pages() {
		if ( is_author() || ( isset( $_GET['author'] ) && ! is_admin() ) ) { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification
			global $wp_query;
			$wp_query->set_404();
			status_header( 404 );
			nocache_headers();
			remove_action( 'template_redirect', 'redirect_canonical' ); // Sinon WordPress redirige vers /author/identifiant/.
		}
	}

	public static function oembed_no_author( $data ) {
		unset( $data['author_name'], $data['author_url'] );
		return $data;
	}
}

		if ( cm_is_coiffeur() ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_role', 'La liste d\'attente est réservée aux comptes client.', 403 );
		}
		if ( ! $pro || 'cm_pro' !== $pro->post_type || 'publish' !== $pro->post_status ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_404', 'Coiffeur introuvable.', 404 );
		}
		$days = wp_list_pluck( CM_Pros::availability( $pro->ID ), 'date' );
		if ( ! preg_match( '/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/', $date ) || ! in_array( $date, $days, true ) ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_date', 'Choisissez un jour dans les semaines à venir.' );
		}
		$t      = cm_table( 'waitlist' );
		$active = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $t WHERE client_id = %d AND slot_date >= %s AND notified = 0", $uid, cm_now()->format( 'Y-m-d' ) ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		if ( $active >= self::MAX_ACTIVE ) {
			return self::err( 'cm_limit', 'Vous êtes déjà en attente sur ' . self::MAX_ACTIVE . ' jours. Retirez-en un depuis « Mes rendez-vous ».' );
		}
		$exists = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT id FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND client_id = %d AND slot_date = %s", $pro->ID, $uid, $date ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		if ( $exists ) {
			$wpdb->update( $t, array( 'notified' => 0 ), array( 'id' => (int) $exists ) );
		} else {
			$wpdb->insert( $t, array(
				'pro_id'    => $pro->ID,
				'client_id' => $uid,
				'slot_date' => $date,
				'presta_k'  => sanitize_key( (string) $r['presta'] ),
				'created'   => current_time( 'mysql' ),
			) );
		}
		return array( 'ok' => true, 'message' => 'C\'est noté : vous recevrez un e-mail si un créneau se libère le ' . cm_date_label( $date ) . '.' );
	}

	public static function remove( WP_REST_Request $r ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$wpdb->delete( cm_table( 'waitlist' ), array( 'id' => (int) $r['id'], 'client_id' => get_current_user_id() ) );
		return array( 'ok' => true );
	}

	/** Un créneau vient de se libérer : on prévient les clientes en attente pour ce jour (sauf celle qui a annulé). */
	public static function notify( $pro_id, $date, $except = 0 ) {
		global $wpdb;
		if ( $date < cm_now()->format( 'Y-m-d' ) ) {
			return;
		}
		$t    = cm_table( 'waitlist' );
		$rows = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $t WHERE pro_id = %d AND slot_date = %s AND notified = 0 AND client_id <> %d", $pro_id, $date, $except ) ); // phpcs:ignore
		foreach ( $rows as $w ) {
			CM_Emails::waitlist_free( (int) $w->client_id, $pro_id, $date );
			$wpdb->update( $t, array( 'notified' => 1 ), array( 'id' => (int) $w->id ) );
		}
	}

	public static function cleanup() {
		global $wpdb;
		$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( 'DELETE FROM ' . cm_table( 'waitlist' ) . ' WHERE slot_date < %s', cm_now()->format( 'Y-m-d' ) ) );
	}

	/** Effacement RGPD. */
	public static function erase_user( $uid ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$wpdb->delete( cm_table( 'waitlist' ), array( 'client_id' => (int) $uid ) );
	}
}

function cm_table( $name ) {

/** Date/heure actuelle dans le fuseau du site. */
function cm_now() {
	return new DateTimeImmutable( 'now', wp_timezone() );
}

/** Transforme une date (Y-m-d) et une heure (H:i) en objet date du fuseau du site. */
function cm_slot_time( $date, $hour ) {
	$dt = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat( 'Y-m-d G:i', $date . ' ' . $hour, wp_timezone() );
	return $dt ? $dt : null;
}

/** « mardi 28 oct. » */
function cm_date_label( $date ) {
	$days   = array( 'dimanche', 'lundi', 'mardi', 'mercredi', 'jeudi', 'vendredi', 'samedi' );
	$months = array( 'janv.', 'févr.', 'mars', 'avr.', 'mai', 'juin', 'juil.', 'août', 'sept.', 'oct.', 'nov.', 'déc.' );
	$dt     = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat( 'Y-m-d', $date, wp_timezone() );
	if ( ! $dt ) {
		return $date;
	}
	return $days[ (int) $dt->format( 'w' ) ] . ' ' . (int) $dt->format( 'j' ) . ' ' . $months[ (int) $dt->format( 'n' ) - 1 ];
}

/** Prénom affichable d'un utilisateur. */
function cm_user_first_name( $user_id ) {
	$u = get_userdata( $user_id );
	if ( ! $u ) {
		return 'Utilisateur';
	}
	$first = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'first_name', true );
	return $first ? $first : $u->display_name;
}

/** URL d'une page de la plateforme par son identifiant (slug). */
function cm_page_url( $slug, $args = array() ) {
	$page = get_page_by_path( $slug );
	$url  = $page ? get_permalink( $page ) : home_url( '/' . $slug . '/' );
	return $args ? add_query_arg( $args, $url ) : $url;
}

/** Nettoie une liste de valeurs autorisées. */
function cm_clean_list( $values, $allowed ) {
	$values = is_array( $values ) ? $values : array();
	return array_values( array_intersect( array_map( 'sanitize_key', $values ), array_keys( $allowed ) ) );
}

/** Le site demande-t-il un acompte (mode démo) ? */

	return 'demo' === $s['payment'] && (int) $s['deposit'] > 0;
}

/** Adresse IP du visiteur (pour limiter les abus), sans la stocker en clair. */
function cm_ip_hash() {
	$ip = isset( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ) ) : '';
	return substr( wp_hash( $ip ), 0, 16 );
}

/** « 9:30 » → 570 (minutes depuis minuit). */
function cm_minutes( $hour ) {
	$parts = explode( ':', (string) $hour );
	return (int) $parts[0] * 60 + ( isset( $parts[1] ) ? (int) $parts[1] : 0 );
}

/** Téléphone français (ou international) nettoyé, ou chaîne vide s'il n'est pas valide. */
function cm_clean_phone( $phone ) {
	$p = preg_replace( '/[^0-9+]/', '', (string) $phone );
	if ( preg_match( '/^0[1-9][0-9]{8}$/', $p ) || preg_match( '/^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$/', $p ) ) {
		return $p;
	}
	return '';
}

/** Lien « Ajouter à Google Agenda » pour un rendez-vous. */
function cm_gcal_url( $title, $date, $hour, $dur, $location = '', $details = '' ) {
	$start = cm_slot_time( $date, $hour );
	if ( ! $start ) {
		return '';
	}
	$utc  = new DateTimeZone( 'UTC' );
	$from = $start->setTimezone( $utc )->format( 'Ymd\THis\Z' );
	$to   = $start->modify( '+' . (int) $dur . ' minutes' )->setTimezone( $utc )->format( 'Ymd\THis\Z' );
	return add_query_arg( array(
		'action'   => 'TEMPLATE',
		'text'     => rawurlencode( $title ),
		'dates'    => $from . '/' . $to,
		'location' => rawurlencode( $location ),
		'details'  => rawurlencode( $details ),
	), 'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render' );
}

function cm_clean_hair_profile( $in ) {

	$out = array();
	foreach ( cm_hair_questions() as $k => $q ) {
		$v = isset( $in[ $k ] ) ? sanitize_key( (string) $in[ $k ] ) : '';
		if ( isset( $q[1][ $v ] ) ) {
			$out[ $k ] = $v;
		}
	}
	return $out;

/** Fiche cheveux en phrase lisible : « Bouclés, mi-longs, naturels · objectif : définir mes boucles ». */
function cm_hair_profile_text( $p ) {
	$p = is_array( $p ) ? $p : json_decode( (string) $p, true );
	if ( ! $p ) {
		return '';
	}
	$q     = cm_hair_questions();
	$parts = array();
	foreach ( array( 'type', 'length', 'thick', 'state' ) as $k ) {
		if ( ! empty( $p[ $k ] ) && 'nsp' !== $p[ $k ] && isset( $q[ $k ][1][ $p[ $k ] ] ) ) {
			$parts[] = mb_strtolower( $q[ $k ][1][ $p[ $k ] ] );
		}
	}
	if ( ! empty( $p['porosity'] ) && in_array( $p['porosity'], array( 'vite', 'lent' ), true ) ) {
		$parts[] = 'vite' === $p['porosity'] ? 'porosité forte' : 'porosité faible';
	}
	$txt = $parts ? ucfirst( implode( ', ', $parts ) ) : '';
	if ( ! empty( $p['goal'] ) ) {
		$txt .= ( $txt ? ' · ' : '' ) . 'objectif : ' . mb_strtolower( $q['goal'][1][ $p['goal'] ] );
	}
	return $txt;
}
